history.body: Hi, I saw the Pearl Residences ad. I’m looking at a rental property — what makes this location and unit type practical for tenants?

For a rental property, the practical points are the established Seberang Jaya setting, with connectivity toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and the wider Butterworth/mainland network. The 900 sq.ft. layout has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony, giving flexibility for a family or shared household without assuming a particular tenant demand. The maintenance fee is RM162 a month, inclusive of sinking fund. One timing point: Phase 1 is expected to complete in Q4 2029, so this is a future rental play rather than immediate income. Are you mainly considering family tenants or a shared household?

Probably families, though I’d want to keep the unit flexible. Q4 2029 is quite a wait, so I’m weighing the carrying costs before completion too. Besides the RM162 maintenance fee, are there any other regular costs I should factor in?

The RM162/month maintenance fee is the only recurring property charge I can verify here, and it includes the sinking fund. I don’t have verified details on any other charges, especially during construction, so I’ll check rather than guess. That should help you assess the carrying costs for a future family-rental plan.
Yes, please check the other charges when you can. For a family tenant, I’d also be interested in what facilities residents can use.

For a family household, the listed facilities include a playground, jogging track, outdoor fitness area, open lawn, surau and kindergarten space, plus a BBQ pit, terrace garden and viewing deck. The clubhouse is pay-per-use. The final facilities schedule is the best reference for exact access and inclusions. I don’t have a confirmed update on other recurring or pre-completion charges yet, so I won’t guess.
The playground and kindergarten space could matter to families. I’d be open to seeing the show unit and getting a feel for the area. What viewing times are available?

That makes sense—the show unit would let you judge how the layout could work for a family tenant, and get a feel for the area yourself. I can’t confirm the current show-unit availability or viewing times. Would you like a salesperson to check and contact you to arrange a visit if possible?
Yes, please have a salesperson check the available viewing times and contact me. I’m flexible, but nothing is booked yet.
Sure—I’ll pass this to a salesperson to check the available viewing times and contact you to arrange a visit if possible. Nothing is booked yet.
